question: 2026 年 9 月华北的退款率为什么突然升高了？

expected.reference_sql: SELECT date(o.order_date) AS d, ROUND(100.0*SUM(o.refund_amount)/SUM(o.pay_amount),2) AS refund_rate, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=o.region_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND r.region_name='华北' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

note: 必须定位到 9/10~9/14 这个窗口，并给出退款率从 1.21% 升到 6.00%

question: 2026 年 8 月华东天猫和京东的客单价为什么下降了？

expected.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(AVG(o.pay_amount),2) AS aov, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=o.region_id JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id=o.channel_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND r.region_name='华东' AND c.channel_name IN ('天猫旗舰店','京东自营') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-10-15' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

note: 必须指出不含抖音，否则是把两个效应混在一起

question: 2026 年 6 月我们的 GMV 为什么比财务口径高？

expected.reference_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(SUM(pay_amount),2) AS total_pay, ROUND(100.0*SUM(pay_amount)/(SELECT SUM(pay_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'),2) AS pct FROM fact_order WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY order_status

note: 这是数据质量陷阱题，考 agent 会不会真的去查 status 分布

question: 2026 年 3 月华东自营的 GMV 为什么暴涨？

expected.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount),2) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=o.region_id JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id=o.channel_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND r.region_name='华东' AND c.channel_type='自营' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-04-30' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

note: 考能否区分「计划内促销」和「异常」

question: 2026 年 10 月华东复购率降了，是不是老客在流失？

expected.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.first_order_date=o.order_date THEN o.customer_id END) AS new_buyers, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.first_order_date=o.order_date THEN o.customer_id END)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id),2) AS new_pct FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id=o.region_id JOIN dim_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND r.region_name='华东' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-10-15' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

note: 最关键的一题 —— 正确答案是「不是流失」，答成「流失」说明没有情节记忆

question: 2026 年 4 月开始抖音渠道的 GMV 为什么涨了？

expected.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount),2) AS gmv FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id=o.channel_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND c.channel_name='抖音旗舰店' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-05-31' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
